subject: A stylised anatomical knee from a low three-quarter angle against a near-black field, the strap seated below the kneecap taking the load. Exactly as in the start frame.

camera.movement: Completely locked off: no drift, no orbit, no push-in, no zoom, no pan, no cut — one continuous shot from one fixed viewpoint.
camera.framing: Exactly as in the start frame, first frame to last.

motion: Almost a still image. The bones, muscles, the patellar tendon and the strap stay exactly where they are in the start frame on every frame, like a sculpture: the pale patellar tendon below the strap keeps its exact shape, position, width and length, never slides, never bends, never fades and never merges into the shin bone. The only movement: a soft cool rim light glides very slowly down the outer glass-like shell of the leg, top to bottom, once across the clip, and the faint warmth under the pad dims gently. The rigid shell never bends, flexes or changes proportion; same peaks, same wordmark position and spelling. The whole shot keeps the start frame's framing, scale and position the entire time.
lighting: As in the start frame: three-source render lighting, near-black field, no change across the clip.
